comments.mergedPostDetails:
Possibly caused by worlds that teleport you.

Other players cannot hear or see you when this happens, you are essentially a ghost with a frozen body in spawn.  They see your avatar frozen with your nametag above and cannot hear you even from the frozen position you are at.  This happens very consistently in certain worlds such as terrors of nowhere, usually within 30 minutes.  This bug is hard to detect from the user's end, as they will only think they are being ignored, a friend noticed me frozen in spawn and messaged me, that is the only reason I knew it was happening.  This bug is fresh since  build 1355.

details:
Unclear how to reproduce, other than to stay in an instance for a very long session.

Randomly, other players will see me as frozen in place, and hear my voice coming from my frozen avatar, regardless of my actual location. Rejoining the instance seems to fix the issue for a while.

Not everybody sees me as frozen, though. Some players can see me moving around just fine. It's led to some awkward interactions until people realize what's going on.
